The '''K-57B engine system''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine produced by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The system utilized an array of high-powered maneuvering thrusters, permitting starships to perform the newly-devised [[Koiogran turn]] maneuver&mdash;a tactic that spun the ship 180 degrees to face pursuers and yet maintained the ship's speed.
